sample_unit: resident admission notes (prospective validation set: 155 NYU, 92 UC)

links.outcome: EA2 model discrimination at second institution versus development institution
links.effect: At NYU the binary EA2 model had AUROC/AUPRC 0.85/0.80; at UC the best EA2 model (GatorTron) reached AUROC/AUPRC 0.75/0.69.
links.quote: The GatorTron LLM performed best for EA2 scores AUROC/AUPRC 0.75/ 0.69.

unlisted_practices: Pivoting model design (stepwise D1 classification, binary EA2 model) when initial multi-class models had insufficient performance

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates LLM and NLP models to assess clinical reasoning documentation across two academic medical centers using retrospective and prospective EHR note sets.
